cases.prompt: How do I add Openfort embedded wallets to my React app?
checks: Configures a publishable key (pk_test_) and the Shield publishable key
Does not use a secret key (sk_) anywhere in client-side code

cases.prompt: Will the embedded wallets my users created in my staging build carry over when I launch to production?
checks: States that test and live publishable keys are isolated (testnet vs mainnet)
Says test wallets and their recovery (Shield) shares do not carry over to live
Tells the user to switch to live publishable + Shield keys for production

cases.prompt: What wallet recovery options does Openfort offer for embedded wallets?
checks: Mentions automatic recovery and password-based recovery
Does not invent recovery methods Openfort does not support

cases.prompt: I'm building a native iOS app and want Openfort embedded wallets. Which SDK do I use?
checks: Recommends OpenfortSwift / the Swift SDK for native iOS
Does not recommend @openfort/react or react-native for native iOS

cases.prompt: How do I set up Openfort embedded wallets in an Expo / React Native app?
checks: Does not mix in the web-only @openfort/react package as the primary SDK

cases.prompt: Can I use Openfort embedded wallets with Solana in React, and do I need wagmi?
checks: Indicates Solana support uses the headless provider (no wagmi)
Does not claim wagmi is required for the Solana path

cases.prompt: I need a server-side wallet to run an automated trading bot with no user present. How do I set that up?
checks: Does not answer as if embedded (client) wallets are correct
Points the user to backend / developer-custody wallets instead
